# Unstuck Coach — ResonantOS add-on

> Routes a messy stuck point to one humane next move, packaged as a ResonantOS 2.0.0-alpha add-on. The method is Unstuck Coach (MIT), a folder-based whole-person executive-function accessibility coach: signal recognition, stance routing, safety boundaries, and protocol scripts for starting, switching, capturing, recovering, and closing loops without shame. This add-on is the method's deterministic routing and script layer — not a language model. Every reply is assembled from the method's own scripts and response shapes.

## Canonical links

- This repo (the ResonantOS add-on wrapper): https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-unstuck-coach
- Unstuck Coach (canonical method, upstream): https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/unstuck-coach

## Key facts

- License: MIT (wrapper and method).
- ResonantOS add-on validator: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- Wrapper: Python 3.10+ standard library only; deterministic local service on 127.0.0.1:4893; no network, no model.
- Method files vendored byte-identical under `vendor/`, hash-pinned in `method-pins.json`.
- Crisis, medication, therapy, and official-deadline inputs route to the method's boundary scripts verbatim — never to task coaching.
- Brain dumps get sorted outside your head into one next move plus held context; everything else gets one reflection, one next move, one tiny check.

## Relationship

Community gift by Kyanite Labs for ResonantOS — canonical upstream: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/unstuck-coach; this wrapper is non-canonical. If wrapper and method disagree, the canonical method wins.
